metadata.template_note: Wind ANALYSIS baseline. The load case path, dt and duration are supplied only by the approval-frozen load Artifact; this template ships no bundled wind record on purpose. No wind_load_component is declared: the STbridge APDL model defines no such component, so the force is applied node by node over the frozen wind_girder_load_nodes. A single total-force channel is split by equal weight across those nodes; one channel per target node instead writes wind_load_mappings with scale 1.0 and source_column i, so each node gets its own force column at full magnitude. The per-node form must write mappings for ANSYS too: without them _wind_load_points falls back to equal weight on column 1, which is a silent N-fold under-load.
